topic.title: Active Travel / LCWIP / Walking, Wheeling and Cycling Delivery
topic.source_contract: local authority and scheme identity, LCWIP or network plan, route evidence, walking and cycling audits, accessibility, design standards, statutory consultation, land and highway powers, funding, approvals, construction, opening, usage, safety and maintenance monitoring evidence

sources.publisher: Department for Transport and Active Travel England

scope_guards: An LCWIP route is not a funded construction scheme.
A funding allocation is not technical approval.
A design drawing is not completed infrastructure.
Consultation support is not land or highway authority.
Construction completion is not evidence of route accessibility.
Opening is not measured mode-shift or safety improvement.
National targets are not local scheme outcomes.
No score or promotion is written without exact scheme, approvals, delivery, opening and monitoring evidence.
